reasoning: As of my knowledge cutoff (April 2024), there is no indication of imminent US military ground operations in Iran. While US-Iran tensions exist, direct ground combat operations would represent a major escalation. The specific criteria require regular active-duty personnel (excluding special ops, contractors, advisors) to physically enter Iranian territory for combat. This is a high bar. Historical precedent shows such operations are rare. The timeframe (June-December 2025) is relatively short. Geopolitical dynamics could shift, but absent concrete indicators of planned operations, the baseline probability remains low.
